audit_status.source_base: Greek Galatians text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for restoration, burden-bearing, sowing/reaping, doing good, circumcision boasting, cross, new creation, marks of Jesus.

verses.restored: Siblings, even if a human is overtaken in some misstep, you who are spiritual restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness, watching yourself lest you also be tested.

familiar.text: Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted.

verses.restored: Bear one another's burdens, and in this way fulfill the Law of Messiah.

familiar.text: Bear ye one another’s burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.

verses.restored: For if anyone thinks oneself to be something, being nothing, one deceives oneself.

familiar.text: For if a man think himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.

verses.restored: But let each test one's own work, and then one will have the boast in oneself alone and not in another.

familiar.text: But let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.

verses.restored: For each will bear one's own load.

familiar.text: For every man shall bear his own burden.

verses.restored: Let the one being instructed in the word share in all good things with the one instructing.

familiar.text: Let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teacheth in all good things.

verses.restored: Do not be deceived; the Divine is not mocked. For whatever a human sows, this also one will reap.

familiar.text: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.

verses.restored: Because the one sowing into one's own flesh will reap decay from the flesh, but the one sowing into the Spirit will reap age-long life from the Spirit.

familiar.text: For he that soweth to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that soweth to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting.

verses.restored: And let us not grow weary in doing the beautiful/good, for in proper season we will reap, not fainting.

familiar.text: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.

verses.restored: So then, as we have season, let us work the good toward all, and especially toward those of the household of trust.

familiar.text: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith.

verses.restored: See with what large letters I wrote to you by my own hand.

familiar.text: Ye see how large a letter I have written unto you with mine own hand.

verses.restored: As many as want to make a good face in flesh, these compel you to be circumcised, only so that they may not be pursued/persecuted for the cross of Messiah.

familiar.text: As many as desire to make a fair shew in the flesh, they constrain you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ.

verses.restored: For not even those being circumcised themselves keep Law, but they want you to be circumcised so that in your flesh they may boast.

familiar.text: For neither they themselves who are circumcised keep the law; but desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.

verses.restored: But may it not be for me to boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Messiah, through whom the world has been crucified to me and I to the world.

familiar.text: But God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.

verses.restored: For neither circumcision nor uncircumcision is anything, but new creation.

familiar.text: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.

verses.restored: And as many as will walk by this rule, peace upon them and mercy, and upon the Israel of the Divine.

familiar.text: And as many as walk according to this rule, peace be on them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.

verses.restored: From now on let no one give me troubles, for I carry the marks of Jesus in my body.

familiar.text: From henceforth let no man trouble me: for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus.

verses.restored: The grace of our Lord Jesus Messiah be with your spirit, siblings. Amen.

familiar.text: Brethren, the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.

translation_notes: Bearing one another's burdens and each bearing one's own load are complementary: communal care and personal responsibility.
New creation in 6:15 is the final interpretive anchor over circumcision/uncircumcision.
Israel of the Divine in 6:16 should be handled carefully without supersessionist certainty; preserve ambiguity.
